title: Why Do House Centipedes Appear and How Can You Reduce Them?

seo.title: Why House Centipedes Appear and How to Reduce Them
seo.meta_description: House centipedes usually find moisture, shelter, and other insects. Reducing dampness and prey is more useful than chasing individual centipedes.
seo.search_intent: Understand why house centipedes appear and reduce encounters by addressing moisture, shelter, entry points, and abundant insect prey.

excerpt: House centipedes are not after pantry food. They hunt other small arthropods, so repeated sightings can be a clue that the home offers moisture and prey.
content_html:
House centipedes prey on other arthropods. Repeated sightings can indicate that the building offers moisture, hiding places, and a steady supply of small insects.

Notice where they appear

Basements, bathrooms, laundry areas, and plumbing penetrations are common locations. An occasional individual wandering in from outdoors is different from persistent indoor activity.

Reduce persistent moisture

Repair leaks, improve ventilation, and address condensation. A dehumidifier can help in a genuinely damp basement after the source of moisture is understood.

Remove shelter and reduce prey

Vacuum dust, dead insects, and webbing; organize boxes resting in damp corners. If cockroaches, silverfish, or other insects are abundant, that population may be supporting centipedes.

Seal entry routes

Inspect baseboard gaps, pipe penetrations, doors, and windows. Weatherstripping and sealing reduce movement without blanket pesticide treatment.

Know when the pattern deserves more investigation

High continuous activity together with obvious dampness or many other pests is a reason to investigate the environment. A pest professional can identify the species and contributing conditions without treating the entire home indiscriminately.

Reducing moisture and prey usually reduces centipede encounters as a side effect.

faq.question: Why do I see them mostly in the bathroom?
faq.answer: Moisture and small insect prey make bathrooms and basements favorable areas.

faq.question: Does one centipede mean a serious infestation?
faq.answer: No. An occasional wanderer is different from frequent activity in several rooms.

faq.question: How can I reduce them without spraying everywhere?
faq.answer: Control moisture, seal entry points, remove hiding places, and address the insects they feed on.
